title: Post-cardiac-surgery: auto-triggering on a sensitive flow trigger
summary: Compliant lungs with low resistance transmit cardiac oscillations to the airway (≈ 4 L/min flow swings). A 1 L/min flow trigger fires on the heartbeat: breaths with no preceding Paw dip, rate above the patient's own.
objectives: Recognize breaths that start without an effort: no Paw dip, no flow inflection, timing locked to the heartbeat.
Fix by switching to a pressure trigger (or a less sensitive flow trigger) without missing real efforts.

fix.note: Pressure trigger 1.5 cmH2O: cardiac Paw swings stay below it, real efforts still trigger.
